units.source_text: 倘若果真如此，正在描绘竹丛和松林小景的，难道不是他而是梅树？

en.t: If that is really so, then is it not he, but the plum tree, that is depicting the little scene of bamboo thickets and pine woods?

units.source_text: 因此，这幅画与其取名“竹松小景”，不如叫“梅树”更为确切。

en.t: Therefore, rather than calling this painting "A Little Scene of Bamboo and Pine," it would be more accurate to call it "Plum Tree."
